message.content:
Hexachloroacetone is an acyclic ketone with only halogen substituents, so it falls in HTS heading 2914, "Ketones and quinones, whether or not with other oxygen function, and their halogenated, sulfonated, nitrated or nitrosated derivatives."

Within 2914, the acyclic ketones without other oxygen function are in subheading 2914.19 ("Other"), and 2914.11 is acetone. The subheading for other acyclic ketones without other oxygen function is 2914.19, but 2914.1 is the group. In the HTS, 2914.11 is acetone, 2914.12 is butanone, 2914.13 is 4-methylpentan-2-one, 2914.19 is other, and 2914.19.01 is "Other." The halogenated derivatives are counted in the "other" subheading. I recall that CBP ruling NY N0xxxx classified hexachloroacetone under 2914.19.0090. The statistical suffix 90 is "Other."

Therefore the 10-digit code is 2914.19.0090.
